cases.name: equal_publication
obligations: actual contended acquisition of equal bytes
one shared image with distinct complete runtime references
retiring one workspace preserves the other reference and image
maintenance rejects until the last runtime reference is retired

cases.name: different_publication
obligations: actual contended acquisition of different bytes
distinct complete images and runtime references
retirement and maintenance of one image preserve the other image and reference

cases.name: observation_across_retirement
obligations: actual observer acquires original target snapshots and hold
runtime retirement preserves the observation hold and image
archive uses retained bytes after private workspace removal
maintenance rejects until observation release

cases.name: equal_references_with_observer
obligations: equal publication retains separate runtime references
observer holds the shared image while each runtime retires
last observation release preserves the unreferenced image until explicit maintenance

cases.name: cancelled_runtime_owner
obligations: cancel the admitted publisher while it holds a populated inspection transaction before mutation
consume actual terminal worker and group results
the cancelled owner reference remains conservative custody
explicit inert retirement uses preserved acquisition data only after worker settlement

cases.name: cancelled_observer_owner
obligations: cancel the admitted observer after retaining its complete hold and snapshots
consume actual terminal worker and group results
maintenance still rejects the unresolved observation reference
archive and release use exact retained observation data without recreating target state

first_failure_rule: Retain first error and owned settlement; no producer replay or successful-run promotion.
ordering_rule: Use controller commands and lock/transaction dependencies. Do not compare independent worker clocks or require arbitrary cross-stream arrival order.
